verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents creating flags on a $0 forever tier with unlimited flags, environments that run through production, and CLI-based flag setup. Community users report that flag changes stream to clients via server-sent events, so a toggle takes effect live. Nothing in the evidence shows the onboarding is fast enough to go from signup to a live production toggle in minutes; the only adoption anecdote describes a 24-hour hackathon implementation. missing for 10: a documented quickstart or time-to-first-flag onboarding flow, explicit documentation of the on/off kill-switch toggle, and independent hands-on evidence of minutes-from-signup time-to-value.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up
